name: toy_pilot
limitations: Data are synthetic: the generator's class signal and donor nuisance are set by hand, so absolute numbers carry no biological meaning.
Donor count is small, so donor-level intervals are wide and small differences between models are not resolvable.
Model selection uses the validation split only; the test split is evaluated once, so these numbers are not tuned estimates.
Routing weights describe contribution to the fused representation, not causal dependence on a view.
No approved real dataset is present, and no result from this configuration transfers to real data.
